name: Cal Poly Pomona
tagline: Shopping at Cal Poly Pomona: Farm Store, Bronco Bookstore, and More
description: Cal Poly Pomona is an agritourism farm in 4102 S. University Drive, CA, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
